Our instant bond was unlike any friendship I’ve ever had. You had a light and joy that never failed to bring a smile to my face every time I saw you, and that is the Mia I’ll always remember you as. Your strength, confidence, and lovable spirit inspired me and so many others everyday. All of our countless memories, laughs, and hugs will be forever in my memory. I honestly wouldn’t be the person I am today without you, and I’m so lucky that God has allowed me to meet such a beautiful soul. I would do anything for one more hug and to hear your laugh one more time. I love you endlessly my hapa twin. Rest easy angel ♾️🪽

To know you was to love you 🧡
Jeremiah 29:11

caption:
To my dad, you’ve been the rock to our family. You inspired me to dream big and chase those dreams to the best of my ability. The early and late night drives, the countless hours you spent with me on perfecting my game, the lessons that came after. But most importantly you showed me to be the truest and most authentic version of me . You taught me to pour my love into others. 

Life is hard, and sometimes takes a turn that was so unexpected. I’m not mad, I understand that the paths that the lord makes for us don’t always make sense but in the end there will be peace and understanding. 

You’ve given so much! And now I want to give back to you. My Dad needs your prayer. He was currently diagnosed with stage 3 cancer. As someone who has been my hero my whole life I want to give back to you Dad! Littles loves you so much!! We all do. In my bio I have a go fund me that we have started. My family and I appreciate all the love and support . We have loved all the prayers being sent our way! Love you Daddio <33

caption:
These past couple of weeks a lot of the focus has been on baby Eli with him being born and his baby blessing.  Even for me too, a lot of my focus has been on baby Eli that I forgot who really is my #1 priority.  So I just wanted to take this time to focus on MY baby riah:) This wife of mine is the most amazing person I know.  And one of the most inspiring things that I got to witness was everything that Riah endured during her labor with Eli.  She experienced some crazy things that day that even I don’t know how she did it.  I am so proud of her and the way she overcame everything that day.🥹❤️

I admire every part of riah from her strong and out going personality to her big heart that she has to love me and everyone around her.  There’s no words that I can say that can really describe how much I adore riah.  She deserves everything good in this life and more. 

Love you Riah, thanks for being the best mommy and wife for me and Eli. 😘

caption:
Danke Würzburg! Für eine unglaubliche Saison 2024/25 und so viel mehr. Ich bin dankbar, dass ich meine ganze Zeit als Jugendspieler hier verbringen und so viel lernen durfte. Danke an meine Coaches, die Vertrauen in mich hatten, den Staff rund um den Court und meine Teammates.

Vielen Dank an die Würzburg Baskets Organisation und das beste und lustigste Office! 
Und natürlich ein riesengroßes Danke an den Fanclub und alle Würzburger Fans. Ihr macht die Spiele zu etwas ganz Besonderem! Die Stimmung in unserer Turnhölle ist einzigartig und hat mich immer angespornt. 

Es lässt sich kaum beschreiben, wie viel mir die Menschen bedeuten, die ich hier getroffen habe und mit denen ich in meiner bisherigen Karriere zusammenarbeiten durfte. Und auch wenn es mir schwerfällt, jetzt Abschied von meiner (Basketball-)Heimat zu nehmen, bin ich doch gespannt und freue mich auf das nächste Kapitel.

caption:
Hey friends! Just a little update for y’all🙂

Unfortunately, the week before Regionals, I dislocated my patella during training on floor. I had surgery to reconstruct my MPFL, and I’m beginning the road to recovery. 

This was far from how I wanted my club career to end. I had made so many improvements leading up to my senior season, and I had so many goals left to be fulfilled. However, I’m ending this chapter with so many amazing memories. I’m so grateful for all the support from my Scega and UW family during my recovery. Big thank you to Dr. Liu and his amazing team! 

Counting down the days till I’m back and stronger than ever, but in the meantime, I look forward to contributing to the GymDawgs in any way I can. Trusting in God’s plan🫶🏼

caption:
Last week, we spent time with patients at Seattle Children’s and experienced therapeutic gaming in action. I had an amazing time getting to connect with my guy Zion. Using video games intentionally, the gaming specialists help patients cope with the challenges of hospitalization, building skills and resiliency that can benefit them long after they leave the hospital. The gaming team visits over 200 patients a month and are funded by the generosity of donors. Please consider donating to our team fundraising page dedicated to expanding the program and supporting the growing needs of patients at Seattle Children’s.

Our team fundraising page can be found here: https://give.seattlechildrens.org/UWFootball
